title: Planul general de conturi contabile
notes: Chapter II (the nomenclature) as restated by OMF 100/2019 and amended by OMF 171/2019, in force from 1 January 2020, transcribed from the Ministry of Finance's consolidated text. Each account's nature (activ or pasiv, and whether it is rectificativ, de calculație or de colectare – repartizare) is from its own sentence in chapter III where there is one, from the opening of classes 6 and 7 otherwise, and from chapter I's general rule for the three accounts that state none (172, 262, 344). OMF 111/2021 is read: it changed only correspondent accounts in the descriptions of 143, 254 and 316, nothing this file holds. OMF 135/2019 is read too: it amends only the methodological indications of OMF 188/2014, not the chart. Abrogated in 2019 and so absent: accounts 312 and 413, subaccount 7143. Names keep the act's spelling (î, "sînt"); the PDF's cedilla ş and ţ are written as ș and ț. The Russian names (nameRu) are from the same two acts' Russian text; see translations.ru. That text cites the original order as Официальный монитор 2013 № 177-181, ст. 1225, where sources[0] says nr. 233-237, art. 1534: one of the two is to be checked in the 2013 gazette.

ru.note: The Russian names are chapter II as OMF 100/2019 restated it in the Russian edition of Monitorul Oficial, with OMF 171/2019's removal of 7143 applied: the same two acts the Romanian names come from, so the two lists cover the same 517 codes, checked code by code. The table's text layer is in a font whose Cyrillic letters sit 0x1D6 below their code points (the PDF draws 'ɇɟɡɚɜɟɪɲɟɧɧɵɟ' for 'Незавершенные'); the names were decoded by that shift, read row by row against the merged cells of the table, and the decoding was checked against the rendered pages 112 and 117. Names keep the act's spelling, misprints included: 'инвесиции' (1424, 2524), 'долгсрочных'/'долгсрочные' (143, 1431, 1432), 'предоствленные' (1422, 2522), 'часно-государственному' (2345), 'обязательтсва' (5222), 'строне' (7114), 'финасовых' (7222), and 'аффилированным сторонами' (4222). Never translated by us: a name missing from the Russian text would be left out, and none is.

closing.notes: The closing entries at the end of the reporting period (perioada de gestiune), as chapters I and III state them: income (class 6) and expenses (class 7) settled into 351, whose balance is the period's net result and goes to 333, so 351 ends the period with no balance. Class 8's management accounts close into balance-sheet or result accounts by the entity's own calculation, before this. A non-commercial organisation uses 336 where a company uses 333 (chapter III, account 336); not encoded here. Page numbers are the physical pages of the Ministry of Finance's consolidated PDF named in sources[0].

source.quote: Conturile din clasa 6 “Venituri” sînt conturi de pasiv. În creditul acestor conturi pe parcursul perioadei de gestiune se înregistrează cu total cumulativ de la începutul perioadei veniturile recunoscute în conformitate cu standardele de contabilitate, iar în debit – decontarea la finele perioadei de gestiune a veniturilor acumulate la rezultatul financiar total.

Conturile din clasa 7 “Cheltuieli” sînt conturi de activ. În debitul acestor conturi pe parcursul perioadei de gestiune se înregistrează cu total cumulativ de la începutul perioadei cheltuielile recunoscute în conformitate cu standardele de contabilitate, iar în credit – decontarea la finele perioadei de gestiune a cheltuielilor acumulate la rezultatul financiar total.

În debitul contului 351 “Rezultat financiar total” se înregistrează decontarea cheltuielilor suportate și profitului net al perioadei de gestiune în corespondență cu creditul conturilor: 333, 711, 712, 713, 714, 721, 722, 723, 731 etc.
În creditul acestui cont se înregistrează decontarea veniturilor acumulate și pierderii nete a perioadei de gestiune în corespondență cu debitul conturilor: 333, 611, 612, 621, 622, 623 etc.

resultHasNoBalance.quote: Contul 351 “Rezultat financiar total” la sfîrșitul perioadei de gestiune nu are sold.
